fields.label: On social media, Bali can look like the perfect backdrop for an influencer lifestyle—or a course som
fields.default: On social media, Bali can look like the perfect backdrop for an influencer lifestyle—or a course someone is trying to sell. I used to joke that I had come to do exactly that. Not really. My parents and brother came to visit me in Thailand shortly before we flew together to Bali in November 2024. We had a week to enjoy the island as a family before my next study minor began.

fields.label: I stayed in Denpasar while studying Event Management at UNTRIM University. The campus was about a fi
fields.default: I stayed in Denpasar while studying Event Management at [UNTRIM University](https://international.untrim.ac.id/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/21-22-Factsheet-Event-Management-1-Bali.pdf). The campus was about a five-minute scooter ride away. Over the next three months, Bali became a place of shared routines, spontaneous plans and experiences I still talk about—with classmates, family and the people I met there.

fields.label: If I could go back to see the people I met and share those experiences with my family again, I would
fields.default: If I could go back to see the people I met and share those experiences with my family again, I would be there in a heartbeat. For a longer stay, though, the crowds, traffic and pollution changed how I felt about the island. Thailand still has my heart as my favourite place in the region.

fields.label: Some days were for the beach at Sanur or a walk along Kuta’s promenade. Other days meant heading out
fields.default: Some days were for the beach at Sanur or a walk along Kuta’s promenade. Other days meant heading out to the Ubud Monkey Forest, seeing the rice terraces at Tegallalang, or hiking Mount Batur. Bali also had its late nights: I went out at the large beach clubs Finns and Atlas, then found myself making plans for another early start.

fields.label: One of the most surreal experiences was swimming with dolphins in Lovina and seeing bioluminescent a
fields.default: One of the most surreal experiences was swimming with dolphins in Lovina and seeing bioluminescent algae after dark. It is hard to forget a night when the water itself seems to glow.

fields.label: About a five-minute walk from my hotel was a local place called Warunk WOW. Most of the students I k
fields.default: About a five-minute walk from my hotel was a local place called [Warunk WOW](https://www.instagram.com/warunkwowkwb_bali/?hl=en). Most of the students I knew had barely heard of it. That was part of the charm: it felt like a local hangout rather than another stop on a visitor’s checklist.

fields.label: During the day, I could stop by for coffee or lunch in its open internet-café space. Upstairs, a sma
fields.default: During the day, I could stop by for coffee or lunch in its open internet-café space. Upstairs, a small club room—around 200 people—hosted local DJs or a band. It kept a 24/7 rhythm: daytime café, then a club upstairs every evening. I ended up there almost daily, got to know the staff and regulars, and became a familiar face. I might even have been a little iconic in that room—at least, that is how I remember it.

fields.default: During the break in my studies, my classmates and I made trips to the islands around Bali: Nusa Lembongan, Nusa Ceningan, Nusa Penida, Lombok and the Gili Islands. We celebrated New Year’s Eve at Mad Monkey, a well-known party hostel on the Gilis.

fields.label: This clip is from Alas Kedaton Monkey Forest, where I filmed huge fruit bats hanging among the trees
fields.default: This clip is from [Alas Kedaton Monkey Forest](https://kebudayaan.kemdikbud.go.id/bpcbbali/pura-dalem-kayangan-kedaton/), where I filmed huge fruit bats hanging among the trees. They are flying foxes from the *Pteropus* group, which includes [some of the world’s largest bats](https://ejournal.brin.go.id/treubia/article/view/9414). Seeing them gathered in the forest was a very different wildlife moment from visiting the monkeys in Ubud.

fields.label: Beautiful memories, difficult realities.
fields.default: Beautiful memories, difficult realities.

fields.label: I want to be honest: I have some regret about choosing to live on Bali for three months. It is not b
fields.default: I want to be honest: I have some regret about choosing to live on Bali for three months. It is not because of the people I met, the culture I got to know or the fun I had. It is because the island felt far too crowded for me.

fields.label: Traffic could turn a five-kilometre ride into an hour on the road. The beaches on Bali itself were n
fields.default: Traffic could turn a five-kilometre ride into an hour on the road. The beaches on Bali itself were not always as beautiful as the ones I had seen online; the nearby islands offered the clearer water and scenery I had imagined.

fields.label: I also noticed litter across public areas, plastic being burned, and air that felt heavily polluted.
fields.default: I also noticed litter across public areas, plastic being burned, and air that felt heavily polluted. After more than fifteen minutes on a scooter, I could sometimes run a fingernail over my skin and see a dark mark. That made the pollution feel very real to me. These are my impressions from the places I visited, and one of the reasons I do not expect to return to Bali soon.
